'''Chapter 510''' is titled "Straw Hat Crew vs. Combat Weapon".

==Cover Page==
[[CP9's Independent Report]] Vol. 18: "The Candy Pirates Appear in St. Poplar Harbor".

The captain of the [[Candy Pirates]] is menacing some townsfolk.

==Short Summary==
[[Borsalino|Kizaru]] has defeated 3 of the [[The Eleven Supernovas|Supernovas]]. The [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] finally after so much effort, defeated [[Pacifista|"Kuma"]].

==Long Summary==
[[Scratchmen Apoo|Apoo]] joins the battle and manages to knock [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] down. Apoo uses this chance to make a quick escape, but Kizaru quickly gets up and easily knocks out Apoo, [[X Drake|Drake]] and [[Basil Hawkins|Hawkins]]. Kizaru is then seen talking to [[Sentomaru]] on a [[Baby Den Den Mushi]] who is telling Kizaru to quickly capture [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] and [[Eustass Kid|Kid]].

Back at Grove 12, where the Straw Hats are fighting the copy of [[Bartholomew Kuma|Kuma]], [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] gets knocked out by Kuma since his wounds from his previous battle with Kuma have not yet healed. [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] successfully manages to land a "Roseo Metel" attack on Kuma. Kuma quickly recovers and just as Kuma is about to attack Chopper, [[Franky]] attacks with "Strong Hammer" and "Franky Boxing". Kuma quickly retaliates and punches Franky but [[Nico Robin|Robin]] saves Franky just before he hits the ground with "Spider Net". Brook then attempts a "Swallow Bond En Avant" from the air but Kuma's tough skin prevents any damage. Usopp barely manages to save Brook with "Atlas Suisei" just as Kuma is about to fire a beam at him. Kuma then targets [[Nami]] with one of his beams but Robin closes his mouth with "Ochenta Fleur: Cuatro Mano Shock" causing Kuma to fire the blast in his own mouth giving Nami the chance to unleash a "Thunder Lance Tempo" on him. This does little however, except for making the copy mad. He then goes "berserk" and Zoro tells [[Sanji]] to send Kuma toward him. Sanji then attacks with "Diable Jambe, Flambage Shoot" kicking him to Zoro who unleashes "Asura, Makyusen". Luffy then activates Gear Third and uses "Gigant Rifle" with the chapter ending there.

*The [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] all worked together and defeated "[[Pacifista|Kuma]]".
